ambient_definitions.source: abbrev Core (l r : ℕ) := _root_.Matrix (Fin l) (Fin 2 × Fin r) ℝ
noncomputable def mass {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (v : I → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ i, v i ^ 2

def complexCore {l r : ℕ} (A : Core l r) :
    _root_.Matrix (Fin 2 × Fin r) (Fin l) ℂ := fun out a => (A a out : ℂ)
abbrev PrimitiveBasis (qubits : Nat) := Fin qubits → Fin 2
noncomputable def pairNorm (a b : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)

noncomputable def marginal {n : Nat} (f : PrimitiveBasis (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    PrimitiveBasis n → ℝ := fun b => pairNorm (f (Fin.snoc b 0)) (f (Fin.snoc b 1))
noncomputable def normSq {n : Nat} (f : PrimitiveBasis n → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ b, f b ^ 2

def equivPermutationMatrix
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (equiv : ι ≃ ι) :
    _root_.Matrix ι ι ℂ := fun row column =>
  if row = equiv column then 1 else 0

abbrev LCUIndex (coefficient selector system : Type*) :=
  coefficient × (selector × system)

def controlledSystemEquiv
    {coefficient selector system : Type*}
    (permutation : selector → system ≃ system) :
    LCUIndex coefficient selector system ≃
      LCUIndex coefficient selector system where
  toFun index :=
    (index.1, (index.2.1, permutation index.2.1 index.2.2))
  invFun index :=
    (index.1, (index.2.1, (permutation index.2.1).symm index.2.2))
  left_inv index := by
    simp
  right_inv index := by
    simp

def selectLift
    {coefficient selector system : Type*}
    [DecidableEq coefficient] [DecidableEq selector] [DecidableEq system]
    (permutation : selector → system ≃ system) :
    _root_.Matrix
      (LCUIndex coefficient selector system)
      (LCUIndex coefficient selector system) ℂ :=
  equivPermutationMatrix (controlledSystemEquiv permutation)

formal_items.formal_statement: ∀ {l r : ℕ} (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.Core l r), A * A.transpose = 1 → ∀ v : Fin l → ℝ, QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.mass (Matrix.vecMul v A) = QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.mass v
¬ (∀ {l r : ℕ} (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.Core l r), A * A.transpose = 1 → ∀ v : Fin l → ℝ, QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.mass (Matrix.vecMul v A) = 1)

∀ {l r : ℕ} (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.Core l r), A * A.transpose = 1 → Matrix.conjTranspose (Matrix.of (fun (out : Fin r × Fin 2) (a : Fin l) => (A a (out.2, out.1) : ℂ))) * (Matrix.of (fun (out : Fin r × Fin 2) (a : Fin l) => (A a (out.2, out.1) : ℂ))) = (1 : Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l) ℂ)

¬ (∀ (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.Core 1 2), A * A.transpose = 1 → (fun (out : Fin 2 × Fin 2) (a : Fin 1) => (A a (out.2, out.1) : ℂ)) = QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A)

¬ (∀ {l r : ℕ} (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.Core l r), A * A.transpose = 1 → (QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A) * (QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A).conjTranspose = 1)

∀ {l r : ℕ} (A : QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.Core l r), A * A.transpose = 1 → (((QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A) * (QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A).conjTranspose) * ((QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A) * (QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A).conjTranspose) = (QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A) * (QuantumBlockEncoding.TensorTrainCanonical.complexCore A).conjTranspose)

¬ (∀ (f g : QuantumBlockEncoding.PrimitiveBasis 1 → ℝ), QuantumBlockEncoding.RealAmplitudePreparation.marginal (fun w => f w + g w) = (fun b => QuantumBlockEncoding.RealAmplitudePreparation.marginal f b + QuantumBlockEncoding.RealAmplitudePreparation.marginal g b))

∀ {coefficient : Type} {selector : Type} {system : Type} [Fintype coefficient] [DecidableEq coefficient] [Fintype selector] [DecidableEq selector] [Fintype system] [DecidableEq system] (permutation : selector → system ≃ system) (row column : system × (coefficient × selector)), Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℂ ℂ ((Equiv.prodAssoc coefficient selector system).symm.trans (Equiv.prodComm (coefficient × selector) system)) (QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift permutation) row column = if row = (permutation column.2.2 column.1, (column.2.1, column.2.2)) then (1 : ℂ) else 0

¬ (∀ (permutation : Bool → Bool ≃ Bool) (row column : Bool × (Bool × Bool)), Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv ℂ ℂ ((Equiv.prodAssoc Bool Bool Bool).symm.trans (Equiv.prodComm (Bool × Bool) Bool)) (QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift permutation) row column = if row = (permutation column.2.1 column.1, (column.2.1, column.2.2)) then (1 : ℂ) else 0)

∀ {coefficient : Type} {selector : Type} {system : Type} [fc : Fintype coefficient] [dc : DecidableEq coefficient] [fs : Fintype selector] [ds : DecidableEq selector] [fx : Fintype system] [dx : DecidableEq system] (permutation : selector → system ≃ system), (@QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift coefficient selector system dc ds dx (fun s => (permutation s).symm) * @QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift coefficient selector system dc ds dx permutation = 1) ∧ (@QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift coefficient selector system dc ds dx permutation * @QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift coefficient selector system dc ds dx (fun s => (permutation s).symm) = 1)

¬ (∀ (permutation : Bool → Bool ≃ Bool), @QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift Unit Bool Bool inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance (fun s => (permutation (!s)).symm) * @QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift Unit Bool Bool inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance permutation = 1)

¬ (∀ {coefficient : Type} {selector : Type} {system : Type} [fc : Fintype coefficient] [dc : DecidableEq coefficient] [fs : Fintype selector] [ds : DecidableEq selector] [fx : Fintype system] [dx : DecidableEq system] (first second : selector → system ≃ system), @QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift coefficient selector system dc ds dx first * @QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift coefficient selector system dc ds dx second = @QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift coefficient selector system dc ds dx (fun s => (first s).trans (second s)))

∀ {coefficient : Type} {selector : Type} {system : Type} [fc : Fintype coefficient] [dc : DecidableEq coefficient] [fs : Fintype selector] [ds : DecidableEq selector] [fx : Fintype system] [dx : DecidableEq system] (first second : selector → system ≃ system), @QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift coefficient selector system dc ds dx second * @QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift coefficient selector system dc ds dx first = @QuantumBlockEncoding.Robin.ComplexLCU.selectLift coefficient selector system dc ds dx (fun s => (first s).trans (second s))

∀ (k : ℕ) (p q : Polynomial ℝ), p.natDegree ≤ 2 * k + 1 → q.natDegree ≤ 2 * k + 1 → (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval (-1) = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval (-1)) → (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval 0 = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval 0) → p = q

¬ (∀ (k : ℕ) (p q : Polynomial ℝ), p.natDegree ≤ 2 * k + 2 → q.natDegree ≤ 2 * k + 2 → (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval (-1) = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval (-1)) → (∀ j ≤ k, (Polynomial.derivative^[j] p).eval 0 = (Polynomial.derivative^[j] q).eval 0) → p = q)
